summary_1line: Ascetics describe the man-eating demon Lavana; Rama asks who will slay him, Bharata volunteers, but Shatrughna respectfully asks to undertake the task instead.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shatrughna rises from a golden seat, bows before Rama, and asks permission to fight the demon while Bharata stands nearby in the royal court.
Ascetics with matted hair stand before Rama describing the monstrous Lavana who devours animals and men in the dark forest of Madhuvana.
